gaps.explanation: Schedule is 23,333 short. The governmental funds statement (p5) prints General column Other miscellaneous 126,266 and Total receipts 882,815, and 'Transfers from other funds 193,339'. The General Fund combining schedule (p12) prints Other miscellaneous 102,932, Total receipts 859,481 and 'Transfer from other funds 216,673': 23,334 is classified as a transfer on p12 but as a receipt on p5 (882,815 - 859,481 = 216,673 - 193,339 = 23,334). Schedule = 859,481 (p12) + Bond Fund 204,606 (p10) = 1,064,087; statement lines 1,087,420 (printed 1,087,421; 1 is printed rounding, report_discrepancies). 23,334 - 1 = 23,333. Both printed as is; no fix.

Schedule is 208,273 above the statement. The statement (p5) prints Bond Fund 'Debt service (208,274)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (JSON other_financing), so Total disbursements 2,153,441 (lines 2,153,440) exclude it. The Bond Fund budget-and-actual schedule (p10) prints it among DISBURSEMENTS: Debt service - principal 162,536 + Debt service - interest 45,399 + Other 340 = 208,275. Schedule total 2,361,713 - 208,275 = 2,153,438 for the General Fund combining schedule lines (p12, printed total 2,153,441). Remaining -2 is printed rounding (p10 lines 208,275 vs p5 208,274; p12 lines vs printed total). No fix.

Schedule is 23,334 above the statement. General Fund combining schedule (p12) prints 'Transfer from other funds 216,673'; the governmental funds statement (p5) prints General 'Transfers from other funds 193,339'. The 23,334 difference is the amount the statement counts in Other miscellaneous receipts (126,266 on p5 vs 102,932 on p12) - the mirror of the revenue gap. Bond Fund transfer from other funds 0 (p10). Both printed; no fix.
